title: Compare inertia across cluster counts
description: You collect clustering results for an elbow curve.

steps.description: You fit standardized data with k from one through six. Each call uses ten initializations and appends the returned inertia.

steps.question: Which cluster count has the lowest recorded inertia in this comparison?
steps.answer: k=6 has the lowest recorded value, 81.53. The recorded values decrease across the tested counts.

steps.description: You plot each tested k against its inertia and title the chart Elbow Curve. Every tested count receives an axis tick.
You print rounded inertia pairs, from 600.0 at k=1 to 81.53 at k=6. This block displays the comparison and leaves the cluster-count choice to you.
